name: norcaster
description: Route Claude Code through the Norcaster AI Runtime Control Plane: guided setup, pre-submit prompt checks, a governed status line, enforcement notifications with Decision Audit links, and permissioned one-time forwarding.

api_key.title: Norcaster API key
api_key.description: Your personal Norcaster API key. One key per developer is what makes Decision Audit attribution per-developer. Recommended: a key bound to your deployment, created at https://www.norcaster.com/dashboard/connect-tool?tool=claude_code (scopes runs:write and deployments:read); then leave the deployment ID empty. A key from Settings → API keys works too, with the deployment ID set (add deployments:write there for simulate_policy).

deployment_id.title: Deployment ID
deployment_id.description: The gateway deployment to bind and watch. Leave it empty when your API key is bound to exactly one deployment: the gateway then uses that one, and configure writes no X-Norcaster-Deployment-Id header. Otherwise it is needed.

api_url.title: Gateway base URL
api_url.description: Norcaster gateway base URL. Self-hosted: point at yours.

portal_url.title: Portal base URL
portal_url.description: Norcaster portal base URL, used for Decision Audit links.
